title: Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation for Long-Tailed Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.29508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult. We revisit this problem through the lens of shortcut learning, where models prefer the easiest predictive cues (e.g., background or textures) over object-centric semantics, especially under scarce and biased supervision. We find that this tendency is amplified for tail classes: limited examples often share similar contexts, making non-semantic signals highly correlated and thus tempting shortcuts, whereas head classes with diverse appearances and environments encourage more stable object-focused representations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD), a plug-and-play framework that transfers object-focused explanations from head to tail classes. SRCD operates in the Class Activation Map (CAM) space, where a CAM provides a class-specific spatial evidence map for a prediction. SRCD aggr

translated_title: 面向长尾识别的抗捷径CAM蒸馏
translated_abstract: 真实世界的数据集通常遵循长尾分布，这使得对尾部类别的泛化变得困难。我们通过捷径学习的视角重新审视这一问题——在捷径学习中，模型倾向于选择最简单的预测线索（如背景或纹理）而非以物体为中心的语义，尤其是在监督信号稀缺且有偏的情况下。我们发现这种倾向在尾部类别上被进一步放大：有限的样本往往共享相似的上下文，使得非语义信号高度相关，从而诱使模型走捷径；而头部类别由于外观和环境多样，能够促进更稳定的以物体为中心的表示。基于这一观察，我们提出了抗捷径CAM蒸馏（SRCD），这是一个即插即用的框架，能够将头部类别中以物体为中心的解释迁移到尾部类别。SRCD在类激活图（CAM）空间中运行，CAM为预测提供特定类别的空间证据图。
tldr: 提出抗捷径CAM蒸馏框架SRCD，通过将头部类别以物体为中心的类激活图解释蒸馏到尾部类别，有效缓解长尾识别中尾部类别因上下文相似而容易学习捷径的问题。
en_tdlr: We propose Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD), a plug-and-play framework that distills object-focused CAM explanations from head to tail classes to mitigate shortcut learning in long-tailed recognition, where tail classes' similar contexts make non-semantic signals tempting predictive cues.
